# Kids Garden Community

> > An online community platform for educators, teachers, and garden leaders sharing resources, discussions, and best practices for youth gardening, farm-based education, and school garden programs.

Hosted by KidsGardening and powered by Higher Logic, this community forum connects garden educators across regions to collaborate on student projects, share funding opportunities, discuss inclusive practices, and support farm-to-school initiatives. The community features regional groups, topic-specific discussions, and connections to organizations like the American Horticultural Society and Yellow Farmhouse Education Center.

## Key Topics

- School garden programs
- Farm-to-school education
- Youth leadership development
- Student garden projects
- Pollinator gardens
- Native plant landscaping
- Neurodivergent student support
- Farm-based education
- Grant funding opportunities
- Community gardening
- Early childhood education (ECE)
- Outdoor classroom management
- Inclusive teaching practices
- Regional gardening resources

- [Funding source!](https://community.kidsgardening.org/discussion/funding-source): Seed Money Challenge crowdfunding opportunity for garden projects
- [Important Update: Gardener's Supply Gift Cards (Use Before Year-End)](https://community.kidsgardening.org/discussion/important-update-gardeners-supply-gift-cards-use-before-year-end-1): Urgent notice about Gardener's Supply gift card expiration deadline
- [Seeking volunteers to gather state resources](https://community.kidsgardening.org/discussion/seeking-volunteers-to-gather-state-resources): Call for volunteers to compile regional gardening resources by state
- [Call for Sessions Deadline January 16](https://community.kidsgardening.org/discussion/call-for-sessions-deadline-january-16): AHS 2026 Youth Garden Symposium session proposal deadline reminder

## Inclusive & Accessible Education

- [best resources for supporting neurodivergent kids in an outdoor ed setting](https://community.kidsgardening.org/discussion/best-resources-for-supporting-neurodivergent-kids-in-an-outdoor-ed-setting): Discussion on resources for neurodivergent students in outdoor classrooms
- [November Community Chat on Inclusive Holiday Celebrations](https://community.kidsgardening.org/discussion/november-community-chat-on-inclusive-holiday-celebrations): Community chat on inclusive holiday celebrations in garden programs

## Farm-Based & Youth Leadership Programs

- [Virtual Workshop: building trust and supporting youth leadership on the farm - April 3 and 10th](https://community.kidsgardening.org/discussion/virtual-workshop-building-trust-and-supporting-youth-leadership-on-the-farm-april-3-and-10th): Youth leadership & food justice workshop with Sharing the Harvest Farm
- [Yellow Farmhouse Education Center 2024 Summer Institute](https://community.kidsgardening.org/discussion/yellow-farmhouse-education-center-2024-summer-institute): Summer institute on regenerative agriculture at Stone Acres Farm CT
- [Teen Farm and Garden Programs: mentorship and evaluating](https://community.kidsgardening.org/discussion/teen-farm-and-garden-programs-mentorship-and-evaluating): Zoom discussion on teen farm programs, mentorship, and evaluation
- [Bringing farm animals to the classroom/school](https://community.kidsgardening.org/discussion/bringing-farm-animals-to-the-classroomschool): Discussion on experiences bringing farm animals into school settings
- [The Latest Farm to School Podcast Episode is LIVE!](https://community.kidsgardening.org/discussion/the-latest-farm-to-school-podcast-episode-is-live-24): Farm to School podcast on blue catfish in Maryland school meals
